hop_replay_bifurcation.comment: served / provider_consumed / billable are three independent columns; collapsing any two is lossy by construction. pipe_usd is the only money that moves and stays > 0 on a hit. estimated_provider_usd is the avoided-provider counterfactual and fires ONLY on the hit — a fixture asserting it is 0 on the miss catches the tempting-but-wrong implementation that fills the column on every row.
assertions: hit_row.served_tokens == miss_row.served_tokens (served survives the hit/miss bifurcation)
